research.edition: international Chatarmin public API at api.chatarmin.com/api/public
research.searchCoverage: Official public API is GET/PUT/POST/DELETE https://api.chatarmin.com/api/public/{path} with Authorization Bearer. GET /contacts?page=1&limit=1 is the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck. GET /contacts, GET /contacts/{contactId}, GET /campaigns, and GET /flows are documented reads. Writes, send_message, voucher pools, and webhooks are omitted. Operator is chatarmin.com GmbH in Vienna. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Chatarmin platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
